text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just to lock in a gain; I’ll weigh its prospects and portfolio role against the same standard I use for every holding.","Recent gains did not prevent the account from falling later, so I’ll manage overall risk and diversification rather than focus on individual winning trades.","I’ll avoid adding to positions simply because I’m checking prices often; each buy or sell should follow a clear rationale and respect my available cash."]}
